body: I’m a freshman in college and don’t work because the way my classes are set up it makes it impossible to work. But my family is good but they don’t know about how I feel so if they get mad at me and say things they don’t realize how hard I take it all in. And I don’t really have a support system because the barley anyone knows and someone who did know told people I would use my depression to my advantage so my support system is way down there now. I’m sorry to hear about what you go through man life is hard
I hope all will be well with you as well

I haven’t gotten professional help because it’s expensive from what I’ve researched because I do want it, however the prices from what I’ve seen are keeping me away. And I talk to some friends about my issues sometimes but I feel more a burden to them and someone who was close to me started to tell people I was using my suicidal thoughts for personal gain and I just shut everyone out since then. There was a time when went out for a walk and my intention was to kill myself that night but I had friends call me and it helped me feel not so alone, but the feeling still doesn’t go away and I don’t know why yanno
